name: workspace
//type: Deliberately NOT `module`. api/[...path].ts compiles under this package.json, and marking the root ESM makes Vercel emit an ESM function — where pino's internal require("tty") is illegal and the function dies at import with FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED. Measured: the ESM bundle throws 'Dynamic require of "tty" is not supported', the CommonJS bundle loads. It was briefly set to `module` to allow a top-level await in lib/db; that await is gone, so CommonJS is both correct and safer here.

scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm run typecheck:api && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
